description: This file defines the RejectedPromise class which implements the PromiseInterface, representing a promise that has already been rejected. It includes methods to handle rejection, wait for the promise, and retrieve its state.

classes.name: RejectedPromise
classes.description: A class representing a promise that has been rejected, implementing PromiseInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the reason for rejection, throws an exception if initialized with a promise.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Handles callback for rejected promises, returning a new promise based on the rejection.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Shortcut for then() with only an onRejected callback.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the promise to resolve or reject; throws if unwrapped.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the state of the promise, which is 'rejected'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Throws an exception since a rejected promise cannot be resolved.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Throws if attempting to reject a promise with a different reason from its initial rejection.
